item.title: Pluto demoted to dwarf planet 20 years ago today
item.description:
Waypoint is curating and commenting on third-party reporting. Original publisher: EarthSky Communications.
Summary: Pluto is the largest of many small bodies in the outer solar system. That's partly why it was demoted from major planet to dwarf planet in 2006. The post Pluto demoted to dwarf planet 20 years ago today first appeared on EarthSky .
